scripts.deploy:build: echo "Downloading public repository..." && curl -L -o sushimist-menu-temp.zip https://github.com/sushimist-menu/sushimist_menu/archive/refs/heads/main.zip && echo "Extracting repository..." && unzip sushimist-menu-temp.zip -d ./temp-menu-extracted && echo "Contents of extracted directory:" && ls -R ./temp-menu-extracted/sushimist_menu-main && echo "Copying config file..." && cp ./temp-menu-extracted/sushimist_menu-main/config.ts ./src/config.ts && echo "Cleaning up temporary files..." && rm -rf ./temp-menu-extracted && rm sushimist-menu-temp.zip && echo "Starting main build command..." && npm run build && echo "Contents of dist directory after build:" && ls -R dist
